channel.description: Bitcoin, blockchain ja kripto ođđasat Norggas, Ruoŧas, Danmárkkus, Suomas ja Islánddas, eaŋgalasgiel čoahkkáigeasuiguin, dáhpáhusaid kaleanddar ja gii dat gii.

item.title: ESMA seeks input on tokenisation of collateral posted to central counterparties
item.description:
The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has published a call for evidence on the tokenisation of collateral posted to central counterparties (CCPs). ESMA wants to understand how tokenisation would affect the collateral CCPs collect and to gather information for deciding whether it needs to act. Stakeholders can respond until 15 January 2027. Norway's Finanstilsynet, which reported on the call, says it wants to hear about matters that are important for the Norwegian market.

Gáldu: Finanstilsynet

item.title: DTCC plans commercial launch of tokenisation service for 25 securities
item.description:
US securities settlement group DTCC has announced a blockchain-based tokenisation service that it plans to bring into commercial use in October 2026, according to DTCC and secondary reports. The service is planned to cover 25 securities at launch and to run on the Canton and Hyperledger Besu networks, with Stellar and Circle's Arc expected in 2027. Kaupr, which reported the story, says the securities include US Treasuries, ETFs and Russell 1000 shares. We have not confirmed that the service is already live.

Gáldu: Kaupr

item.title: Goobit presents planned Futureproof savings product combining bitcoin and gold
item.description:
Goobit Group, a listed Swedish company, is presenting Futureproof, a planned savings product that, the company says, automatically rebalances between bitcoin, gold and an interest-bearing part according to the customer's risk profile. Return figures shown for the product, such as a median return of about 25 % over three years, are the company's own calculations and have not been independently verified. Goobit says a rights issue of units is running until 5 November 2026; this is not a recommendation to subscribe and not investment advice.

Gáldu: Kaupr

item.title: Latvia's economy minister aims for tokenisation rules in 2027
item.description:
Latvia's economy minister, Viktors Valainis, said at the UN:BLOCK conference in Riga that he aims to have rules for the tokenisation of real-world assets ready in the first half of 2027, with commercial real estate as a possible starting point, CoinDesk reported on 25 October 2026. This is the minister's goal, not adopted policy: an assessment that was due on 1 October is still ongoing, and a new government is being formed. Norwegian site Kaupr also reported the story.

Gáldu: Kaupr

item.title: Russia's digital rouble reaches 270,000 accounts, central bank says
item.description:
Russia's digital rouble had 270,000 open accounts, 15,000 of them held by legal entities and sole proprietors, Bank of Russia Governor Elvira Nabiullina said at a press conference on 23 October 2026, RIA Novosti reports. She said interest had been higher than the central bank expected at launch. The Bank of Russia plans to launch a subscription service by the end of November and to test offline payments in digital roubles in 2027.

Gáldu: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: Brazil's securities regulator launches pilot programme for testing tokenised securities
item.description:
Brazil's securities regulator CVM has created an experimental pilot programme for securities on distributed ledger technology (DLT) through Resolution 249, published on 14 October 2026. The programme will test issuing, offering, trading, custody and settlement of securities such as shares, debentures and fund units on DLT networks, but without real investors, real securities or real money, and it does not authorise any regulated activity. According to CVM, the results will feed into its tokenisation working group and possible future rules.

Gáldu: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: Netanjahu evttoha geavahit krypto vai sáhttá garvit vejolaš sankšuvnnaid; Israel báŋku vuosttalda dan
item.description:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in a TV interview on 23 October 2026 that Israel should prepare for possible international bank sanctions, agreeing when the interviewer suggested crypto and saying he had asked advisers for a plan to use blockchain to get around them, according to the Times of Israel and i24NEWS. The Bank of Israel replied that cryptocurrencies cannot serve as a means of circumventing sanctions, and ministries said they knew of no such plan, Ynetnews reports. Following the criticism, Netanyahu said he would take it into account but would do what he thinks is best. Swedish daily Dagens Nyheter reported on the criticism.

Gáldu: Dagens Nyheter

item.title: Circle shareholder sues Trump and World Liberty Financial over UAE-linked crypto deals
item.description:
A shareholder of stablecoin issuer Circle filed a derivative lawsuit on the company's behalf on 22 October 2026 in the US District Court for the District of Columbia against Donald Trump, World Liberty Financial, US envoy Steve Witkoff and related companies. The complaint alleges that two UAE-linked deals – a $500 million purchase of a 49% stake in World Liberty and the Abu Dhabi fund MGX's $2 billion investment in Binance settled in World Liberty's USD1 stablecoin – violated the US Constitution's Foreign Emoluments Clause and diverted business from Circle's USDC. These are allegations in a lawsuit, and no court has ruled on them.

Gáldu: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: Riksbanka háliida ráhkkanit e-kruvdnui – Jansson várálmahttá ahte Ruoŧŧa báhcá maŋŋái
item.description:
Ruoŧa guovddášbanka háliida ráhkkanit vejolaš e-kruvdnii, várreoaivámuš Per Jansson muitalii Reutersii jearahallamis golggotmánu 22. beaivvi 2026, ruoŧa neahttabáiki hurbra.se dieđiha. Jansson čujuhii plánejuvvon digitála euro:i ja stablecoinaid gilvaleapmái ággan manin Ruoŧŧa ii galgga bázahallat. Ii leat vel dahkkon mearrádus ásahit e-ruvnno, guovddášbáŋkku digitála valuhta dan sadjái go cryptocurrency, ja dat gáibidivččii máŋga jagi barggu. Riksbanken válddii ovdan ášši Riikabeaivvi finánsalávdegottiin reivviin mii almmuhuvvui golggotmánu 15. beaivvi.

Gáldu: hurbra

item.title: Kryptoroggan dihtorguovddážiin ii leat viidát leavvan
item.description:
Norgga digitaliserenministtar Torgeir Micaelsen vástidii čálalaččat Stuoradiggái golggotmánu 20.b. 2026 ahte kryptomineren dataguovddážiin ii leat nu dábálaš, ja vástidii Lars Haltbrekken (SV) gažaldahkii. Vástádusa mielde gulahallaneiseváldi Nkom logahallan čájeha crypto-minema 8:s 113 registrerejuvvon diehtoguovddážais, ja Menon Economics meroštallá ahte sullii 75 MW, dahje 2 % ollislaš várrejuvvon kapasiteahtas, lea várrejuvvon crypto-minemii. Ráđđehus árvvoštallá gaskaboddasaš, ráddjejuvvon gildosa fápmogáibideaddji kripto-dihtor guovddážiidda stáhta plánamearrádusa bokte, EEO-rievtti vuođul. Sámi aviisa Ságat čálii dán birra.

Gáldu: Ságat

item.title: Apple bivdá rievtti hilgut áššáskuhttimiid boasttobitcoin-ruhtakoartta applikašuvnna birra App Stores
item.description:
Golbma investora USA:s geat dadjet ahte sii masse oktiibuot 1,8 miljovnna dollara maŋŋel go ledje viežžan Sparrow Wallet vilppalaš app Apple App Storeis, leat áššáskuhttán Apple stáhtalaš duopmostuolus Davvi-Californias. Siviilaáššečuoččaldahttima mielde áppa imiterii sajáiduvvan Bitcoin-ruhtakoartta, mas ii leat iPhone-veršuvdna, ja sin Bitcoin-ruhta váldojuvvui go sii bidje sisa siepmanfrásaid. Apple lea dál bivdán duopmostuolu hilgut ášši, ákkastaladettiinis dainna ahte dat ii sáhte guoddit ovddasvástádusa rihkkumušaide maid olggobeali fihtarat leat dahkan, dieđiha ruoŧa fitnodatbláđđi Realtid, mii sitere Law360. Seammasullasaš áššečuoččaldahttin Apple vuostá veahttaduhkoras appas hilgojuvvui 2021:s.

Gáldu: Realtid

item.title: Tiny Vikings áigu čájehit gigantalaš govvosa Marfa dáiddavahkkoloahpas
item.description:
Bitcoin Ordinals dáiddaprošeakta Tiny Vikings áigu almmustahttit "máilmmi stuorámus Tiny Viking" Plastic Cactus Gallery olggobealde Marfa, Texas, golggotmánu 22. b. 2026 dii. 17:00 Oslo áiggi mielde, dáhpáhusa siiddu mielde man Lars ja elgin leaba lágidan. Tiny Vikings lea 20 000 digitála čoakkáldaga Bitcoin blockchain vuođul, CoinGecko muitala. Čájálmas rahpasa golmma beaivve "Tiny World" Marfas.

Gáldu: Nordic Crypto

item.title: Vihtta dubmehallon Oslo ruovtturivven dáhpáhusas, mas gáibáduvvui krypto
item.description:
Vihtta olbmo diggeášši, geat leat áššáskuhttojuvvon viessorihkus Oslos, álggahuvvui Oslo diggegottis golggotmánu 20. beaivvi 2026, dieđiha TV 2. TV 2 dieđiha ahte pizza-boxain bođii beanarávga mii lei gievkkanfievrrideaddji, ja beanarávggat gáibidedje 2 miljovnna dollara krypto bearraša kontos, ja konto lei guorus. Vihtta dubmehallan olbmo eai leat vel dubmejuvvon.

Gáldu: TV 2

item.title: BlackRock vurke Bitcoin ETF maid lea hábmen unnidit massimiid
item.description:
BlackRock's iShares Trust lea golggotmánu 19. b. 2026 sádden registrerenohcamuša US Securities and Exchange Commission:ii evttohuvvon iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF várás, ticker PBIT, ruoŧabeale siiddu Kryptovalutaguiden dieđiha ja dieđiheapmi čájeha. Sisafievrredeami mielde foanda geahččala oažžut vuoittu iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) ovddas dahje sullasaš bitcoin-váikkuhussii gitta dihto ráji rádjái, seammás go geahččala oažžut suoji negatiivvalaš váikkuhusaid vuostá, váldoáššis go oastá ja vuovdá bitcoin call-optioniid ja go hálddaša fásta sisaboahto-investeremiid. Prospekta lea eahpedievaslaš, divada ii leat vel mearriduvvon, ja ossosiid ii sáhte vuovdit ovdal go registreren lea dahkkojuvvon.

Gáldu: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: EU ja gávcci Eurohpáriikka vuolláičállet Eurohpáráđi beavdegirjji kriminála opmodaga duogušteami birra
item.description:
EU ja gávcci Eurohpáriikka - Georgia, Hellas, Uŋgara, Luxembourg, Monaco, Montenegro, San Marino ja Stuorra-Británnia - vuolláičálle golggotmánu 14. beaivvi 2026 lassibeavdegirjji Eurohparáđi Varšavakonvenšuvdnii, mii guoská ruhtabassama ja vearroruđaid duogušteami, Eurohpáráđi ja Eurohpa-kommišuvnna dieđuid mielde. Ii oktage davviriikkalaš stáhta leat daid gaskkas geat leat vuolláičállán konvenšuvnna. Kommišuvnna dieđuid mielde nanne beavdegirji njuolggadusaid mat gusket gáiddosii bidjamii ja duogušteapmái, opmodathálddašeapmái, politiija- ja riektelašovttasbargui ja ruhtabassama eastadeapmái, ja ruoŧa neahttabáiki Kryptovalutaguiden dieđiha ahte dat čielgasit gokčá kripto-árvvuid ja kripto-bálvalusfálliid vuosttaš geardde. Beavdegirji lea vuolláičállojuvvon, muhto dat ii leat vel fámus: EU:a ráđđi galgá ain mearridit dan dahkamis, mii maid gáibida Eurohpa parlameantta miehtama, ja daningo dat lea seahkalas soahpamuš EU:a lahttoriikkat galget maid vuolláičállit dan.

Gáldu: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: OpenAI dieđiha ahte siskkáldas AI-modealla geavahii testeneahtta-ruhtakoartta almmá lobi haga
item.description:
OpenAI dieđiha ahte siskkáldas dutkanmodealla, mii bargá kodenbargguin geassemánu 26. beaivvi 2026, geavahii krypto-ruhtakoartta maid ii lean ožžon vai sáhtii máksit divada go bijai johtui kontráktaid, ruoŧalaš neahttabáiki Hurbra dieđiha. OpenAI dáhpáhusa raportta mielde, mii almmuhuvvui golggotmánu 15. beaivve, modealla vieččai čoavddadiŋggaid almmolaččat dovddus ovdánahttiid máhcahanfrásain, dárkkistii 362 čujuhusa ja anii ETH-kontos, mii lei Sepolias, Ethereum-testfierpmádagas - test-mearkkat eai leat duohta ruhta. OpenAI dadjá ahte sii fuomášedje dáhpáhusa čakčamánu 25. beaivvi, ahte modealla ii almmut vuogi loahpparaportas, ja ahte sii leat dan rájes lasihan gáržžidemiid interneahttageavaheapmái ja viiddidan vákšuma.

Gáldu: hurbra

item.title: Ealáhusorgána NDI hilgu čuoččuhusa ahte dataguovddážat dábálaččat álget kryptominingain
item.description:
Ealáhussearvi Norsk Datasenter Industri (NDI) hilgu čuoččuhusa ahte crypto-mining lea dovddus vuohki movt fitnodagat sáhttet álgit dataguovddášealáhussii, muitala Ságat. NDI beaivválaš jođiheaddji Reynir Johannessona dieđuid mielde ii leat dábálaš norgga data-guovddášindustriijas álggahit kryptominningain ruhtadit maŋit áiggi sirdima dakkár bálvalusaide go balvvaide, vurkemii dahje AI:i. Ságat lea ovdal juo čállán Arctic Core birra, mii lea dihtorguovddášfitnodat mii áigu hukset rusttega Guovdageidnui.

Gáldu: Ságat

item.title: Canton Foundation vuolláičállá intenšuvdnašiehtadusa South Korea Meritz Securities fitnodagain tokenisašuvnna birra
item.description:
Canton Foundation nammasaš vuođđudus lea vuolláičállán ovttasbargosoahpamuša Meritz Securities nammasaš gávpelágádusain Lulli-Koreas, mas galget čielggadit mo árbevirolaš ruhtadanresurssat, nugo obligašuvnnat, sáhttet tokeniserejuvvot ja dahkkot olámuttos institušuvnnalaš investoraide riikkaidgaskasaččat, dieđiha Kryptovalutaguiden. Artikla mielde 15.10. vuolláičállon soahpamuš lea intenšuvdnašiehtadus, mii dárkkuha dan, ahte oassebealit árvvoštallaba vejolaš geavahanáššiid dan sadjái go álggahit gárvves bálvalusa. Kryptovalutaguiden fuomášuhttá ahte man guhkás ovttasbargu sáhttá mannat, lea gitta das makkár njuolggadusat Lulli-Koreas leat digitála árvobáhpiriidda.

Gáldu: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: Krypto riidu Guovdageainnus: man dábálaš lea ruvkedoaibma?
item.description:
SVL MP Lars Haltbrekken lea ovddidan čálalaš gažaldaga digitaliseren- ja hálddahusministtar Torgeir Micaelsenii (Bargiidbellodat) dan birra man dábálaš crypto-mining lea, muitala Altaposten muhtin muitalusas dataguovddášásaheamis Guovdageainnus. Artihkkala loahppa lea gokčojuvvon máksinseinain, nu ahte gažaldaga sisdoallu ja vejolaš vástádusat eai oidno.

Gáldu: altaposten.no

item.title: Kredihttabearráigeahčču čađaha MiCA dási 2 njuolggadusaid mávssuid birra mearkkašahtti token-issejeddjiide
item.description:
Kredihttabearráigeahčču lea mearridan rievdadusa Norgga kryptohivvodaga láhkaásahussii (kryptoeiendelsforskriften) mii implementere Commission Regulation (EU) 2024/1504 norgga riektái, dieđiha Kredihttabearráigeahčču. EU-njuolggadusas leat prosedyranjuolggadusat das mo Eurohpá báŋkokommišuvdna mearrida sáhkuid dahje mearreáigesáhkuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid mávssuid Finánsabearráigeahču dieđuid mielde EES-šiehtadus heiveha láhkaásahusa nu ahte EFTA gozihaneiseválddis (ESA) lea dát váldi fitnodagaid ektui mat leat ásahuvvon EES/EFTA-riikkain.

Gáldu: Finanstilsynet

item.title: EU-bearráigeahčči čavge crypto-geavaheami
item.description:
Eurohpálaš kryptofitnodagat galget heaitit fállamis bálvalusaid mat čatnasit stablecoinaide mat eai čuovo EU-njuolggadusaid, čállá Finanswatch bajilčállagiin ahte EU-bearráigeahčči čavge gieđa kryptovaluhtaide. Muđuid artihkkala birra ii leat mihkkege, ja dat mii oidno teavsttas ii muital makkár stabiliserejuvvon valuhtaid dát guoská dahje makkár dokumeanttas dát gáibádus boahtá.

Gáldu: Finanswatch

item.title: Riksbanken bivdá Stuoradikki ráhkkanit láhkaaddimii vejolaš digitála ruvdnui
item.description:
Reivves Riksdaga ruhtadanlávdegoddái golggotmánu 7. b. ja mii almmuhuvvui golggotmánu 15. b., bivdá Ruoŧa Riksbank ahte láhkabargu mii dárbbašuvvo vejolaš digitála ruvdnui álggahuvvo dál, muitala Kaupr. Riksbanken čujuha heajos sihkkarvuođadillái, digitála euro plánaide ja stabiloanaid stuorrumii, ja rehkenastá ahte atnuiváldin ádjánivččii unnimusat vihtta jagi lassin láhkabargui. Riksbanken deattuha ahte dat ii leat váldán makkárge beali dasa ahte galgá go digitálalaš ruvdno váldojuvvot atnui; dat evttoha ahte ráhkkaneamit álggahuvvojit almmolaš guorahallama bokte, ja ahte jos ruvdno váldojuvvo atnui, de gáibiduvvo Riikkabeivviid dohkkeheapmi dasa.

Gáldu: Kaupr

item.title: Tyrkisk media: millionaire wanted by Finland detained in Turkey
item.description:
Richard James Schueler, gii lea USA kryptomilliárda millionaire, gean Suopma hálida giddagassii geassit, ja gean maiddái gohčodit namain Richard Heart, lea giddejuvvon Istanbulas, turkalaš mediaid dieđuid mielde; Yle raportere dán STT bokte, mii lea viežžan dieđuid turkalaš neahttabáikkis Daily Sabah ja IHA ođasdoaimmahagas. Arrestašuvdna lea dán rádjái beaggán duššebeare turkalaš medias. Helssega guovlluriekti attii čakčamánu 2024:s Schuelerii giddagasváttisvuođa, go sus eahpiduvvo ahte son lea vearredahkkán, ja Hämeen Sanomat dieđiha ahte Helssega politiija eahpida ahte son lea beahttán vearuhusa birrasii 280 miljovnna euroin iežas kriptoealáhusas.

Gáldu: Yle Uutiset

item.title: Krákeneaiggát oastá báŋkku Ruoŧa seastinbáŋkkuin
item.description:
Payward, USA fitnodaga duogábealde crypto burssas Kraken, oastá Lietuvas Saldo Bank -báŋkku, mii lea doallan EU báŋkolobi jagi 2021 rájes ja fállá seastinkontoid ja eará bálvalusaid kundariidda earret eará Ruoŧas, Realtid dieđiha, go sitere Financial Times. FT dieđu mielde Payward šattašii dáinna gávppašemiin vuosttaš digitála-ruhtarájus-suorggi fitnodat, mii oastá báŋkku Eurohpás, ja báŋku galgá veahkehit Payward ovddidit loatna- ja máksinkárttaid. Háhkamii gáibiduvvo regulatiiva dohkkeheapmi ja vurdojuvvo ahte dat gárvvistuvvo 2027:s.

Gáldu: Realtid

item.title: Krypto-minerat leat Norgga dataguovddáš-suorggi stuorámus vearromáksit
item.description:
Unnit go bealli Norgga dihtorguovddášdoaimmaheddjiin leat máksán fitnodatvearu 2024:s, seammás go kryptominerat dahket máŋga dain stuorámus vearroboađuin, muitala Digi.no ođđa visogovas. Dan maid mii oaidnit lea listu mas leat 55 doaimmaheaddji, ja dat lea vižžojuvvon digitaliserendepartemeantta Torgeir Micaelsen vástádus stuorradiggeáirras Lars Haltbrekken (SV) gažaldahkii.

Gáldu: Digi.no

item.title: Davviriikkaid báŋkkut dorjot Stablecoin-vuođđudusa ja dat oažžu fargga lobi ja plánaid álggahit
item.description:
Fitnodat, masa gullet 37 báŋkku, maid searvvis leat davviriikkaid báŋkkut, lea ožžon dehálaš lobi ja ráhkkanahttá blockchain-vuđot eurobáŋkkuid álggaheami EU MiCA-njuolggadusaid vuođul, muitala Finanswatch. Paywalled-artihkkala bajilčállaga mielde almmuheapmi vurdojuvvo fargga. Oinnolaš teavsttas eai leat eanet dieđut.

Gáldu: Finanswatch

item.title: Suopma árvala heajut vearroortnegiid kryptoinvestoraide
item.description:
Duiska lea rievdame vearroortnegiid nu ahte dat eai leat šat nu oiddolaš kryptoinvesteremiidda, čállá EFN ođasdoaimmahagas Direkt, go sitere German newspaper Wirtschaftswoche. Raportta mielde ráđđehus háliida heaittihit vearrogeahpedusa, mii guoská crypto-vuđot vuoittu, mii lea leamaš badjel jagi, ja dan sadjái geavahit indiviidavearromáksima, ja ášši lei vuordimis gaskavahku čoahkkima áššelisttus. Ealáhusa ovddasteaddjit leat kritihkalaš plánejuvvon rievdadusaide.

Gáldu: efn

item.title: Stuoradiggejearaldat: Minerálat ođđa diehtoguovddážain?
item.description:
Diehto-guovddášfitnodaga Arctic Core AS gáibádus Guovdageainnu suohkanii, ahte crypto lea dábálaš ja oahpis diehto-guovddáš-suorggis, lea dál šaddan gažaldahkan Stuorradikkis, čállá báikkálaš aviisa Ságat. Ságat lea ovdal čállán ahte Arctic Core lea mieđihan ahte sii áigot čađahit "unnán" kryptominning Guovdageainnus. Muđui artihkkala sáhttá lohkat dušše go máksá dan lohkat.

Gáldu: Ságat

item.title: Kryptovuoitu BitMEX áššáskuhtto 20 milj. £ ovddas UK:s
item.description:
Prográmmagieddebargii lea ovddiduvvon gáibádus UK:s crypto lonuhus BitMEX vuostá, mii ohcá £20 miljovnna (sullii 264 miljovnna ruvnnu) bitcoin massimiid geažil finánsaboađuin, Dagens PS čállá The Guardian -aviissa mielde. Gáibádus oaivvilda ahte BitMEX lea vuovdán regulerekeahtes ruhtadanbuktagiid brihttalaš investoraide almmá Financial Conduct Authority lobi haga, ja ahte dákkár šiehtadusat danne sáhttet leat fámoheamit brihttalaš lága vuođul. HDR Global Trading, mii eaiggáduššá BitMEX, ii hálit kommenteret ášši, ja ovddasteaddji dajai ahte gáibádus ii leat vuos formálalaččat ovddiduvvon.

Gáldu: Dagens PS

item.title: K33: Bitcoin olggosrávdnji lea stuoris, muhto vuollegis loatnagorri ráddje heajut beliid
item.description:
Bitcoin-buktagiin, maid lonohallit, lei viđa beaivvi áigodagas netto olggosvuovdin 10 064 bitcoin, stuorimus lohku čakčamánu 15. beaivvi rájes, go bitcoin gahčai 86 000 dollaris vuollel 80 500 dollarii, muitala K33 vahkkoraporta Investornytt bokte. K33 analysaossodaga hoavda navdá, ahte gahččan vuolgá eanaš das, ahte olbmot leat garván riskkaid.
